MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 12

2. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 41
   D. 3

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

4. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

5. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

6. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 6
   C. 9
   D. 7

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 5

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

9. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 16

10. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 1

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

12. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 24
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
